context: ProductTable renders a ProductRow (wrapped in React.memo) for each product and tracks which row is selected.
explanation: handleSelect was replaced with an inline arrow function created fresh on every render of ProductTable. Since ProductRow is wrapped in React.memo, it relies on prop identity to skip re-renders — a new onSelect function reference on every render defeats that memoization entirely, so every row re-renders whenever any row is selected, even in tables with hundreds of products. Fix: keep the callback stabilized with useCallback.
